accepted_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: responsive desktop registration-page background for the fictional cross-platform strategy game SHADOWGRID
Input images: Image 1 is the approved login-background style and material reference; Image 2 is the approved corporate-architecture reference. Preserve the visual system, but create a completely new scene and a somewhat more open, welcoming daytime mood.
Primary request: Create a premium ultra-realistic background of an original contemporary strategy campus reception gallery in a fictional German metropolis, suitable for account registration.
Scene/backdrop: a credible indoor-outdoor glass gallery with dark stone, brushed metal, restrained landscaping, and a glimpse of an entirely fictional urban district; no recognizable location or landmark.
Subject: architecture only, expressing a threshold into a strategic economic world through scale, material quality, and daylight rather than symbols or text.
Style/medium: ultra-realistic architectural photography; high-end urban economic strategy simulation; cinematic corporate-thriller restraint; subtle cyber-noir only in grading and materials; physically plausible construction and reflections.
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 landscape intent, intended final size 2048x1152; human eye-level wide composition. Reserve the central 48% of the image from about 12% to 92% height as a calm, slightly darker, low-detail surface for a taller registration form. Put the strongest daylight, landscaping, structural rhythm, and visual depth at the far left and right edges. Keep the upper-left quiet enough for the existing horizontal brand mark. No bright window mullion, horizon, furniture, doorway edge, or focal object behind the form-safe center.
Lighting/mood: soft overcast late-afternoon daylight with restrained warm-gold interior accents; more welcoming and forward-looking than the login asset, but still serious, premium, and controlled.
Color palette: anthracite, dark stone, cool neutral blue-gray, muted natural green, restrained warm gold; no saturated neon or warning red.
Materials/textures: physically plausible glass, brushed metal, concrete, stone, subtle planting, realistic floor wear and scale.
Text: none.
Constraints: wholly original fictional architecture; no people or faces; no text, signage, interface screens, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, readable plates, addresses, flags, uniforms, authorities, weapons, crime symbols, or real brands. High readability under a centered tall form overlay. Must survive cover-cropping at common desktop ratios without losing the form-safe center.
Avoid: reproducing the login scene, copied landmark-photo angles, fantasy skyscrapers, impossible geometry, distorted buildings, floating elements, excessive neon, cartoon, anime, comic, plastic mobile-game rendering, blur, low resolution, compression artifacts, fake writing.
notes: The central dark-stone surface provides an unusually clean safe area for the taller registration form.
The brighter edge lighting distinguishes registration from login while preserving the frozen style system.
No visible person, text, logo, private identifier, authority mark, weapon or illicit activity.
